'''Shimer Londalin''' was a [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] who competed in the [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] [[Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings]]. He barely came in first in the decaped-plus final, edging out [[Mogoyu]].
